title: Celeste Create Hell SMP
description: The official Modded SMP of Celeste Create Hell modpack on Modrinth!
body:
Create is too easy... So we fixed it!

- Finite Resources
- Nothing over the top
- More Energy Consumption
- FOCUS ON CREATE BEING LATE GAME

How did we do this?

- Custom Create Config [worked from the ground up to focus on the beginning of minecrafts gameplay and ensuring everything fits toghether]
- Flowing Fluids... Where now water and lava are finite, you must now manage your water supply! 
- Vanilla Tweaks! Tokens can no longer be crafted, so it is an actual achivement if you get full netherite armor!!!


Are you up for the challenge? Join the discord to join events!
